instruction: I want to enable event sounds so I hear audio feedback for system events. Can you turn this on?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling event sounds. Evaluator verifies the event-sounds setting is set to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: vm_command_line executes 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.sound event-sounds' which directly reads the event-sounds setting
Metric logic is correct: exact_match appropriately compares the command output against expected value 'true\n'
Expected value is semantically correct: 'true\n' matches the actual gsettings command output format when event sounds are enabled
Complete instruction coverage: The single requirement (enable event sounds) is fully verified
State accessibility is good: gsettings command can be executed at any time without requiring UI state or postconfig
Data flow is correct: Instruction requires enabling event sounds → Getter extracts setting state → Metric verifies state is 'true\n'
